# cg api featured-event

The `featured-event` service endpoint. See [`cg api`](index.md) for how these relate to the higher-level commands.

| Command | Summary |
| --- | --- |
| [`cg api featured-event`](#cg-api-featured-event) | FeaturedEvent service commands. |
| [`cg api featured-event find-upcoming-and-ongoing-featured-events`](#cg-api-featured-event-find-upcoming-and-ongoing-featured-events) | Find upcoming and ongoing site-wide featured events. |
| [`cg api featured-event is-codingamer-auto-registered`](#cg-api-featured-event-is-codingamer-auto-registered) | Check whether a codingamer is auto-registered for featured events. |
